topic: M08 Frozen Test Split Offline Benchmark Results & Provenance
problem_statement: Execute single-shot frozen offline benchmark on MovieLens 25M Test split (162,541 users) comparing Popularity Count, Popularity Weighted (m=10), and frozen Spark ALS champion (ALS_R8_REG0.3_ITER10).
root_cause: On the empirical positive Test cohort (111,211 users with test rating >= 3.5), Popularity Count achieves HR@10=0.05357 (5,958 hits) and NDCG@10=0.02721; Popularity Weighted achieves HR@10=0.01884 (2,095 hits) and NDCG@10=0.00742; Frozen ALS Champion achieves HR@10=0.00001 (1 hit) and NDCG@10=0.00001. Test-stage seen filtering strictly excludes seen_u = Train_u ∪ Validation_u (24,837,554 total interactions). 29 positive test targets had 0 ratings in Train and were properly retained as misses in the evaluation denominator.
solution_or_decision: Award M08_ACCEPTANCE_PASS. Persist all 6 benchmark artifacts in artifacts/als/m08. Confirm zero test-leakage and identical positive cohort evaluation across all 3 models without post-hoc tuning.
evidence: Single-shot test run logged in artifacts/als/m08/m08_test_benchmark_results.json. Exact hits: Count 5,958; Weighted 2,095; ALS 1 out of 111,211 positive users.
